title: LULC Change Detection & Carbon Stock Estimation — Lahore District, Pakistan
description: Google Earth Engine pipeline for multi-year (1993–2023) LULC classification using Random Forest and carbon stock estimation aligned with InVEST Carbon Model logic. Underlying data for the submitted manuscript on urban expansion and ecosystem carbon loss in Lahore.
highlights: ~3.15 million metric tons of estimated carbon loss

title: SAR Flood Detection & ML Susceptibility Mapping — Layyah District, Pakistan
description: An open, reproducible remote-sensing study coupling dual-polarisation Sentinel-1 SAR inundation detection, bi-temporal SAR change detection, and an event-based machine-learning flood susceptibility model across Layyah District, Punjab (6,354 km²). Built entirely on open data and released with full GIS exports, training data, and a documented model card.
highlights: Random Forest F1 = 0.962, IoU = 0.928, ROC-AUC = 0.996 on held-out flood events
Chronological event-based validation (train 2003–2014, test 2015–2018) to structurally prevent temporal leakage
19 documented flood events from the Global Flood Database; 547.8 km² (8.6% of district) mapped as high susceptibility
Documents a silent-failure mode in Google Earth Engine raster distance operators that depressed model IoU by 0.025
